General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This Suzuki OEM part attaches to your existing washer tank and pumps water to the washer nozzle for all Geo Trackers & Suzuki Sidekicks from 1989 to 1998.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Windshield Washer Tank Pump
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Geo Tracker 1989 – 1998 All Models
Suzuki Sidekick 1989 – 1998 All Models
